definitionZh: *-webkit-search-results-按钮CSS伪元素代表一个键("search results button"),位于输入类型="search"的左边缘,在点击时显示一个菜单,允许用户从之前的搜索查询中选择. 这个按钮和伪元素是非标准的,只在WebKit和Brink中支持,因此是供应商的前缀. 搜索结果按钮仅在具有结果属性的搜索输入元素上显示.
sourceDefinition: The ::-webkit-search-results-button CSS pseudo-element represents a button (the "search results button") at the left edge of an input of type="search" which when clicked displays a menu which allows the user to choose from previous recent search queries. This button and pseudo-element are non-standard, supported only in WebKit and Blink, hence the vendor prefix. The search results button is only shown on search input elements that have a results attribute.
